content: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position description The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance. This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several. Position Overview We’re seeking a highly motivated, organized, and resourceful Analyst to join the CEO Office. You will work directly with the Chief of Staff (CoS) and the CEO, helping take on whatever comes up. One week that might mean helping the CEO prepare for high-profile events (e.g. World Economic Forum). The next, it might mean crunching the numbers to understand why a key metric is moving, or helping pull together our company kickoff. This role is ideal for a curious, hands-on generalist who is comfortable with ambiguity, learns quickly, and can move between analysis, planning, writing, and execution without losing attention to detail. You will be a trusted partner to the CoS and the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), helping the CEO Office run smoothly and keeping the company aligned. Alongside ad hoc special project work, you will own a few ongoing workstreams: keeping our internal knowledge base accurate and structured so people and AI tools can find and use it, supporting internal events and presentations (e.g. all-hands, company kickoff), and constantly upskilling on the latest AI tools and capabilities to help the CEO Office work better and faster. Position description We are still at the beginning of our growth journey, so we are putting new processes, technologies, and tools in place on a continuous basis. Your role is a pivotal engineering contributor to the tooling and services to automate and enhance the software development lifecycle, empowering our fellow SonarSourcers to deliver with speed, confidence, and security. You would be a member of a team that delivers solutions across all of our 5 offices: Austin (Texas, US), Geneva (Switzerland), Bochum (Germany) and Singapore. As a Major Incident Manager, you use and create automation tools to monitor and observe production infrastructure services both on premises and in the cloud. You are allergic to repetitive tasks, preferring to maximize automation and reliability. You are expert in change management, infrastructure management, system support, and configuration management.

Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow,Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. Position description As a member of one of our platform engineering squads, you will leverage your experience and expertise to design and develop cloud-based solutions. This means implementing massively scalable services, automating all system operations, measuring and continuously improving service quality, and making the lives of other developers easier. You will play a key role in helping our product reach its next stage of evolution and delight our users and customers.

Position description We are hiring a Corporate Accounting Manager to help build and scale our growing finance organization. This role goes beyond traditional close and reporting, you will help design processes, strengthen controls, develop and implement AI tooling, and partner cross-functionally to ensure financial accuracy as our operations grow in complexity. The Corporate Accounting Manager will play a critical role in day-to-day accounting operations while helping evolve systems, policies, and workflows that support multi-entity operations. What you will do Prepare and review journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules across core balance sheet and P&L accounts. Lead process improvement and transformation initiatives that strengthen reporting quality, efficiency, scalability, and controls Identify and implement opportunities to use automation, technology, and AI-enabled solutions within management reporting processes Mentor and develop accounting team members and serve as a trusted resource across the broader finance organization. Assist with ongoing audits and liaise with external auditors Experience and qualifications The ideal candidate will: AI experience Direct experience
